# Proto-Arachnid
Proto-Arachnids are an uncommon sight as most Arachnids believe their bodies to be "good enough" already, regardless, there's still small groups obsessed with body modifcation among them.
## Racial Features - Their blood is [color=#ffa500]copper[/color] based, thus being metabolised from it. - Their blood has a distinct blue color. - They can [color=#1e90ff]eat raw meat without any ill effects[/color], but [color=#ffa500]some foods like chocolate or onions are poisonous[/color]. - Due to their less efficient lungs, they take [color=#ffa500]50% more asphyxiation damage[/color] and recover from it [color=#ffa500]50% slower[/color]. - They receive [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage, 25% more shock damage and 10% more blunt damage[/color]. - Additionally, they receive [color=#1fb0ff]50% less cold damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#B9BF93](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They posses sharp fangs which let them deal [color=red]5[/color] piercing damage with unarmed attacks. - They posses additional sets of limbs, granting them [color=#1e90ff]2 extra pocket slots[/color]. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Sericulture
Arachnids can create Websilk at the cost of getting hungrier, consuming about 4% of their total hunger to produce one bundle of it. They can craft bundles of websilk into various items from clothing and shields to entire walls.
## Chittin and Trinary The arachnid language, known as Chittin, is composed of a complex series of fast clicks generated by the rubbing of antenna. Often described as harsh and sharp sounding, Chittin is an uncommon language to hear in the galaxy due to most species being incapable of producing the sounds necessary to speak it without special implants. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Arachnids have a lifespan similar to that of humans, reaching adulthood at 20 years of age and being able to live up to 150. Arachnid names are given to them upon hatching, often being composed of 3 or more sillables and having been described as "Latin sounding".
